proposals.label: Linear probability model, SEs clustered by user
proposals.rationale: Variants are assigned per user and users return several times, so session rows are correlated; standard errors that ignore this are too small. A user-clustered estimator is the standard correction.
proposals.spec: OLS of converted on treatment with cluster-robust standard errors grouped by user_id; report the coefficient in percentage points, its CI and p-value.
proposals.source: Abadie, Athey, Imbens & Wooldridge (2023), When Should You Adjust Standard Errors for Clustering?, QJE

proposals.label: Keep only engaged sessions (30 seconds or more)
proposals.rationale: Short sessions are low-intent browsing, so restricting to engaged sessions isolates users who actually considered buying.
